item.title: FCC approves the merger of cable giants Cox and Charter
item.description: The Federal Communications Commission has given the go ahead for two of the US' biggest cable providers, Charter Communications and Cox Communications, to merge. item.title: Xiaomi 17 Ultra hands-on: Incredible cameras, but maybe hard to get
item.description: China’s biggest phone makers continue to relentlessly forge ahead with high-spec phones that you may never see in the US. With the Xiaomi 17 Ultra this year, the company has continued its pattern from previous iterations by focusing on powerful camera sensors, huge batteries and… being selective about global availability. item.title: Shuttered studio Bluepoint reportedly pitched a Bloodborne remake, but it got shot down by FromSoftware
item.description: Bloodborne fans may not be happy to hear that a remake was reportedly rejected, but that doesn't mean it's completely off the table. Bluepoint Games, Sony's closed-down studio behind many PlayStation remakes, pitched remaking the classic Gothic horror RPG in early 2025, but was blocked by the game's developer, FromSoftware, according to a Bloomberg report. item.title: Alaska could be the next state to crack down on AI-generated CSAM and restrict kids' social media use
item.description: Alaska's House of Representatives unanimously passed HB47, a bill that imposes sweeping limits on when and how minors use social media apps, along with bans on generating or distributing harmful deepfakes of children. The bill's original form was focused on prohibiting the possession and distribution of sexually explicit images of children using AI, but Alaska lawmakers decided to add amendments that would impose social media restrictions. item.title: Everything announced at MWC 2026: The new Leica Leitzphone by Xiaomi, Honor's ultra-thin MagicPad 4 and more
item.description: MWC 2026 officially gets underway on March 2 and will continue through March 5, but the announcements are already coming ahead of its start. item.title: This retro-inspired handheld comes with Banjo-Kazooie and Battletoads built in
item.description: Who would've guessed we'd get to play the original Banjo-Kazooie on a handheld with just a D-pad in 2026.
